New design is fully in place: 'Your city, in your pocket.' headline, countdown grid (Days/Hrs/Min/Sec), lucide SVG feature chips (30-min delivery, Local food, Live tracking, App-only deals, Push alerts), App Store + Google Play SOON badges, and detailed phone mockup (ZYPHIX header, search bar, Zyphix Now/Eats tiles, Veg/Dairy/Snacks/Pharmacy chips, 'Arriving in 12 min' tracker). ui_bugs.issue: Countdown displays 00:00:00:00 and does not tick. LAUNCH_TS is set to 2026-08-15T09:00:00Z (line 1693 of Home.tsx) which is already in the past at test time (system date is Aug 15, 2026 ~11:16 UTC). The Math.max(0, LAUNCH_TS - nowTs) clamps diff to 0, so Days/Hrs/Min/Sec all render '00' permanently. The countdown IS wired (setInterval every 1s), but the target date needs to be pushed to a future date (e.g. later in 2026 or 2027) for it to visibly tick.

Inline validation message 'Please enter a valid email address.' is implemented in handleNotify but never fires for input 'abc' because the <input type="email"> triggers HTML5 native browser validation popup and blocks form submission before handleNotify runs. The custom validation only ever fires for an EMPTY email. Consider using type="text" with noValidate, or ensure the inline error message is what the user actually sees.

action_items: Update LAUNCH_TS in /app/artifacts/zyphix/src/pages/Home.tsx line 1693 to a future date so the live countdown actually ticks (currently expired -> all zeros).
Optional: switch email input off type='email' or add noValidate on the form so the custom 'Please enter a valid email address.' error is shown instead of the browser's native tooltip.
critical_code_review_comments: Home.tsx is ~3147 lines — well beyond the 700-line guideline. The #app-download section alone spans ~150 lines with inline styles + keyframes. Recommend extracting into src/components/AppDownloadSection.tsx.
LAUNCH_TS is hardcoded inline. Better to expose it via env / config so marketing can update without touching component code, and to prevent 'expired countdown' regressions.
handleNotify swallows non-Error rejections as generic string. Fine for now, but consider logging the raw error for debugging in preview envs where /api/notify (Supabase edge) may 401/500.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The redesign is visually confirmed via screenshot at /app/test_reports/app_download_section.png. The only functional issue is that LAUNCH_TS is already in the past so the countdown shows 00:00:00:00 and does not tick. Once main agent bumps the date, retest by scrolling to #app-download and confirming SEC value changes over 2 seconds.
rca of the issue: Countdown non-ticking RCA: Home.tsx line 1693 `const LAUNCH_TS = new Date('2026-08-15T09:00:00Z').getTime();`. At the time of testing the wallclock is past that timestamp, so `Math.max(0, LAUNCH_TS - nowTs)` returns 0 every tick, producing 00/00/00/00. Fix: change to a future date (e.g. '2026-12-01T09:00:00Z' or move to env var). Reproduce: load '/', scroll to #app-download, observe SEC does not change over multiple seconds.
